content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen is a wall of text with three contact actions (Pokličite, Navodila za pot bar, then the same number and directions again right below) and no visual anchor before the fold.","desktopNote":"The right-hand contact column repeats the header's call and directions links, and the pricing section leaves the whole right half of the page empty.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the duplicated phone and directions links from the hero contact column (phone shows them twice within one screen) and keep a single primary action per screen.","Add a visual element to the hero – a photo of the translator or the office, or a strong typographic mark – so the first screen is not purely stacked text.","Fill the empty right half of the pricing section on desktop by placing the hours/urgent note beside the table or widening the table to the content column."],"blockers":["Phone, hero: 'Navodila za pot' link and phone number appear twice within the first screen (sticky bar and contact block)."]}
